deviations.what: the sap.f.HeroBanner control is newer than 1.71 (sap/f/HeroBanner.js: @ui5-experimental-since 1.152 - an EXPERIMENTAL wrapper around the UI5 Web Components fiori HeroBanner, extending sap.ui.core.webc.WebComponent) and is the whole point of this sample - kept 1:1, the app needs a UI5 release >= 1.152. HeroBanner members used: the actions and endContent aggregations, columnsRatio (sap.f.HeroBannerColumnsRatio Equal), actionsPlacement (sap.f.HeroBannerActionsPlacement BottomStart) and headerBlockPlacement (sap.f.HeroBannerHeaderBlockPlacement Bottom) - all @ui5-experimental-since 1.152 with the control.
